solution: An Expo (React Native) client on iOS, Android, and web talks to a TypeScript API in Azure EU. A person creates an Account, passes the Resident gate and the age floor of 21, and publishes a lean Profile. They discover other Residents in one Pool, nearer first, filtered by age, distance, and languages. Interest is one-way until mutual, then a Match opens chat. Photo verification is optional and unverified Profiles are marked. Block and Report are first-class. Join, discovery, Match, and chat are free. Personal data stays in the EU. The Resident gate mechanism is a design proposal: Cyprus mobile number plus a presence check in the Operating area at join, plus an attestation that primary home is in the Operating area.
screensJourneys: Join: age 21+, Launch language, attestation of primary home, Resident gate, Account created.
Profile edit: photos, first name, age, city, languages spoken, bio. Photo verification entry. Unverified mark visible.
Discovery: distance-aware list or cards of Residents in the Pool who match men-seeking-women or women-seeking-men. Filters for age, distance, languages. Empty, loading, error, populated.
Express Interest from a Profile. Mutual Interest becomes a Match.
Matches list and chat thread. Block and Report from Profile or chat.
Settings: export personal data, delete Account, notification permission, Photo verification status.
apiContract: OpenAPI 3 published from the TypeScript API. Clients use a generated TypeScript client. Version in the URL as /v1. Resources: Account, Profile, Discovery, Interest, Match, Chat, Block, Report, PhotoVerification, DataExport.
testingDecisions: API integration tests are the highest seam for gate, discovery, Interest, Match, Block, and deletion.
Client component tests for Profile, discovery empty/error, unverified mark, and chat thread.
Contract tests from the OpenAPI doc against the generated client.
No live Photo verification vendor in CI; the vendor is stubbed.
k6 against discovery p95. axe against Expo web screens.
outOfScope: Northern Cyprus and matching across the Green Line
Greek UI and Greek-first Cypriots as a core audience
Same-gender matching and matching beyond men seeking women and women seeking men
Events, video calls, and a social feed
Charging for join, discovery, Match, or chat
